changelog:
amazon-reviews-api-skill v0.1.2

- Initial implementation of the skill, enabling automated extraction of Amazon product reviews using BrowserAct's Amazon Reviews API.
- Added the scripts/amazon_reviews_api.py script for fetching and parsing review data by ASIN.
- Provides robust error handling and one-time retry on failures (excluding invalid authorization).
- Monitors execution progress with continuous status logs.
- Supports fetching rich review attributes including reviewer, rating, verified status, and more.
